'''Chapter 566''' is titled "Raid".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color spread]]: The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] relaxing by a stream and enjoying cola.

==Short Summary==
[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] attempts to pass the [[admirals]], but is knocked back by [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] and stabbed by [[Kuzan|Aokiji]], forcing [[Polo Marco|Marco]] to intervene. The executioners attempt to kill [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]], but [[Crocodile]] stops them, forcing [[Donquixote Doflamingo|Doflamingo]] to behead the former [[Shichibukai]]. Unaffected, Crocodile clashes with Doflamingo as the [[Whitebeard Pirates]] breach the wall. As Whitebeard blasts his way through the [[Marines]], [[Sengoku]] states that he and [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] must participate in the war.
==Long Summary==
As the [[admirals]] dodge the projectiles formed from the frozen mast, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] activates Gear Second, hoping to make a straight dash for [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]]. However, [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] easily catches up to him and knocks him aside with a kick at [[Pika Pika no Mi|light-speed]].

Up on the execution platform, the guards are about to execute Ace. However, they are blown back by an unknown force, which is revealed to be an attack by none other than [[Crocodile]]. While [[Sengoku]] wonders why Crocodile would aid his own enemy, the former [[Shichibukai]] notes that he only did it because he did not want to see the [[Marines]] be satisfied. Suddenly, taking everyone by surprise, Crocodile's head comes flying off of his body. [[Donquixote Doflamingo|Doflamingo]], standing behind Crocodile, says that he is jealous that he had decided to side with Whitebeard instead of him. Forming his head back onto his body, Crocodile responds that he is not teaming up with anyone and attacks Doflamingo.

Meanwhile, Luffy has been knocked down, as [[Kuzan|Aokiji]] stabbed him with an ice saber. Hancock screams at Aokiji and prepares to interfere, but instead Marco knocks Aokiji away.

The pirates in the bay, attempting to make their way past the iron wall, all try to swim towards the gateway made by [[Little Oars Jr.]]. As the Marines prepare to fire upon the susceptible pirates, a coated ship suddenly emerges from the sea, allowing most in the water to climb aboard. [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] notes that he never said that all of his ships had surfaced. While the Marines are busy debating whether or not they should aim at Oars Jr. or the ship, Oars Jr. lifts the ship into the air and pulls it through the hole he created. As the pirates prepare to storm the stage, Oars Jr. takes cannon fire, causing him to collapse once more. Whitebeard then leaps into the plaza and, commanded his "children" to keep away, swings his bisento in a circle, knocking away all of the Marines in his path.

With the only Marines still standing being the admirals, a few of the vice admirals, and those upon the podium, the Whitebeard Pirates prepare to make their final charge to save Ace. Sengoku then tells [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] that the two of them will be required to join the war.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Admiral]] [[Sakazuki|Akainu]]'s [[Magu Magu no Mi|devil fruit]] is confirmed to be a [[logia]] type since his body can also turn into magma.
*The executioners make their first attempt to execute Ace but were stopped by Crocodile.
*The [[Whitebeard Pirates]] and their allies finally reach the plaza.
